options.description: First slice accepts an existing SVG board as input, exposes one editing interaction on specimen entries (e.g. edit a single text attribute), validates board kind and rejects non-board or malformed input, and re-exports SVG.

grounded_in.quote: Board input and editing interaction are undecided.

options.label: Option A - SVG-file input with single-attribute edit
options.shows_it_works: An unchanged SVG board round-trips with no unintended changes, and one edited entry re-exports with only that entry changed; invalid input is rejected.
options.tradeoff: Reuses existing boards with no new input format, but requires SVG parsing and board-kind validation rules up front.

options.description: First slice accepts an explicit specimen list supplied by the caller, exposes one editing interaction (add/update one entry) with validation of required fields, and exports an SVG board.

grounded_in.quote: Build a small editable specimen-board exporter for our SVG board utility.

options.label: Option B - Explicit specimen-list input with list edit
options.shows_it_works: A supplied specimen list exports to well-formed SVG, and one list edit re-exports correctly without affecting other entries; invalid entries are rejected.
options.tradeoff: Makes inputs and validation explicit and simple, but does not cover import of existing SVG boards, so a second input path may be needed later.

options.description: First slice fixes one minimal board kind (e.g. fixed grid of N labeled slots), accepts only that shape as input, exposes one editing interaction within that fixed shape, and validates size and label constraints on edit and export.

grounded_in.quote: Build a small editable specimen-board exporter for our SVG board utility.

options.label: Option C - Fixed minimal board kind with constrained edit
options.shows_it_works: A minimal board of the fixed kind exports correctly, an out-of-range edit or oversized label is rejected, and a valid edit re-exports correctly.
options.tradeoff: Narrows board-kind and validation decisions to the smallest scope, but a different board kind later may require rework of the fixed shape.

question: What board input and editing interaction should the first slice support?
scope_proposed: Small editable specimen-board exporter: take a board input, allow at least one editing interaction on specimen entries with input validation, and export an SVG board. First slice limited to one input shape, one editable attribute, and validation with rejection of invalid input; board kind, full input schema, and wider editing scope are left to the decision below.
